decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The proposal is considered acceptable because of its  size, function and temporary nature would not harm the appearance of the site or the locality, and would serve to further the educational operations of St. Marks Catholic School.  The development is therefore in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the mobile classroom shown on the approved drawings shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 6 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on or before five years from the date of permission when the use shall cease
description: Installation of a single storey mobile classroom to rear of school.
